LanguageData.JustStart_ButtonJustStartTooltip: Generate the world, then skip straight to playing: pick a random starting site, set up the ideoligion and accept the scenario's colonists, following the Just Start settings, with no further setup screens.\n\nRight-click for Just Start settings.
LanguageData.JustStart_ChecklistTickToAllow: Tick to allow. None ticked allows all.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsBiomesTooltip: Only start in one of the ticked biomes. With none ticked, any biome can be picked. Biomes vanilla never picks at random, and any excluded below, are still left out.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsExcludeExtremeTooltip: Never start in a biome the game warns about when you settle there:\n{0}
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsTerrainTooltip: Only start on tiles with a ticked terrain.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsFeaturesTooltip: Only start on tiles with every ticked feature.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsGrowingTooltip: The shortest outdoor growing period the starting site may have, as shown on the world map's terrain tab. A year is 60 days.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsTemperatureTooltip: The range the starting site's average yearly temperature must fall in. The full range allows any temperature.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsHostileTooltip: How far the starting site must be from every settlement of a faction hostile to you.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsDefaultIdeologyTooltip:
How Just Start sets up your ideoligion:
- Classic, player only: a classic ideoligion for you; other factions keep theirs.
- Random fixed or Random fluid: a randomly generated ideoligion.
- Classic mode: every faction shares one classic ideoligion.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMemesTooltip: Memes your random ideoligion never gets. Structure memes, such as theist or animist, are not affected.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMemesRequiresRandom: Only used with a random fixed or fluid ideoligion.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsXenotypeTooltip: The xenotype of every starting colonist, or a random one each with Mixed. Anything other than Scenario's choice overrides the xenotypes the scenario sets.
LanguageData.JustStart_XenotypeScenarioTooltip: Starting colonists keep the xenotypes the scenario gives them, such as the sanguophage in The Sanguophage.
LanguageData.JustStart_XenotypeMixedTooltip: Each starting colonist gets a random xenotype from every xenotype loaded.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMixedCustomTooltip: Mixed can also pick the custom xenotypes you have saved in the xenotype editor.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMixedCustomRequiresMix: Only used when the starting xenotype is Mixed.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsAgeTooltip: The biological age range of starting colonists. Ages within it follow the game's usual age spread. The full range allows any age.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsGenderTooltip: The genders of starting colonists. Balanced alternates them so the colony is as even as its size allows.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsPassionsTooltip: The fewest passions, minor or major, each starting colonist has.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMajorPassionsTooltip: The fewest major (burning) passions each starting colonist has.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsCapableTooltip: Starting colonists have no disabled work, from backstories, traits, genes or health.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsViolenceTooltip: Starting colonists are never incapable of violence.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsViolenceIncluded: Included in Capable of all work.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsNoAddictionsTooltip: Starting colonists have no drug addictions.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsNoRelationsTooltip: Starting colonists have no relatives, partners or exes, among themselves or elsewhere in the world.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsResetTooltip: Set every Just Start setting back to its default.
LanguageData.JustStart_ErrorNoValidTile: No starting site on this world matches the Just Start starting site settings.
LanguageData.JustStart_ErrorNoStartingPawns: This scenario produced no starting colonists.
LanguageData.JustStart_ErrorAdjustWorld: The game has not been started. Adjust the world or Just Start settings and try again.
